name: Threat Hunt - Proofpoint click permitted  - Cisco Firepower showing the connection after phishing click
xql_query:
dataset = proofpoint_tap_raw
| filter _log_type = "click-permitted"
| fields clickIP, senderIP, recipient, url, GUID, _time as pp_time
| join (
    dataset = cisco_firepower_raw
    | filter act = "Allow"
    | filter bytesOut >= 10000000
    | fields src as fp_src, dst as fp_dst, dpt,
             bytesOut, suser as fp_user, shost as fp_host,
             msg as fp_msg, _time as fp_time) as fp
  clickIP = fp.fp_src
| filter fp_time >= pp_time
| fields recipient, clickIP, url, GUID, pp_time,
         fp_dst, dpt, bytesOut, fp_user, fp_host, fp_msg, fp_time
alert_name: Threat Hunt - Proofpoint click permitted  - Cisco Firepower showing the connection after phishing click
